description: Which modulus IMPOWER takes (review of CR-321578802, rounds 1 and 2, reviewer 1 B1). Near |z| = 1 (A1:A10, each base raised to the 50000000th power): A1:A3 tell the correctly rounded hypot from the logarithms' modulus, A4:A6 the correctly rounded from x86_64 glibc's, A7:A9 tell it from both, A10 from a full x87 chain. Away from 1 (A11:A16) the two families differ outright: the logarithms' modulus forms the double sum of the squares, which underflows for these bases, where a hypot does not; A17 is IMSQRT of A15's base, evidenced already (probes/eng-imln-modulus-range A80).
